import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { noticedNotifications } from "../../../backend/schema/noticed_notifications";

export const noticedNotificationsCms = customizeTable<typeof noticedNotifications>("noticed_notifications", {
    icon: "Mail",
    display: {
        title: "recipientType"
    },
    listFields: ["id", "type", "recipientType", "readAt", "seenAt", "eventId"],
    fields: {
        type: {
            multiline: true
        },
        recipientType: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "type",
        "recipientType",
        "readAt",
        "seenAt",
        "eventId",
        "recipientId",
        "createdAt",
        "updatedAt"
    ]
});
